stories.title: Jalen Hurts' blood clots reach both lungs, ending his season
stories.summary: Monday morning the Eagles and agent Nicole Lynn said the "superficial" calf clot Jalen Hurts had been cleared to play with in London on Oct. 11 was now a deep vein thrombosis with clots in both lungs; he would go on blood thinners and is expected to make a full recovery. Adam Schefter's "Jalen Hurts will be out for the season" got 97K likes and Karl-Anthony Towns' "Prayers up" 39K, and sympathy turned to anger at the team's doctors after Tom Pelissero framed reports that Hurts had gone about 36 hours without sleep before kickoff as a sign of commitment ("Tom, I respect you as a journalist, but this tweet is garbage"); Lynn later clarified that he had been able to sleep after leaving the hospital. The next day the NFL Players Association called for a full investigation.
